TEXT: [FI] H-How should I say this...

TEXT: [FI] Ahaha...

TEXT: [FI] Now, now, don't just stand there and sulk. How about hurrying up?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Onee-san is waiting for you, isn't she?
